payload.prompt: Crea un pedido para el cliente Luna SL (org. nº 966920963) con los productos Desarrollo de sistemas (5271) a 6950 NOK y Asesoría de datos (3613) a 7000 NOK. Convierte el pedido en factura y registra el pago completo.

payload.goal: Create an order for customer Luna SL with two products, convert the order to an invoice, and register full payment.
success_checks: Customer Luna SL (org. 966920963) exists in the system
Product 'Desarrollo de sistemas' (product number 5271) exists with unit price 6950 NOK
Product 'Asesoría de datos' (product number 3613) exists with unit price 7000 NOK
Order is created with both order lines
Order is successfully converted to an invoice
Full payment is registered against the invoice
Invoice status is marked as paid
risk_notes: VAT rate not explicitly stated; defaulting to 25% (standard Norwegian MVA) — verify if applicable
No invoice date or payment due date provided; system defaults will be used
No payment method or bank account specified; bank account must be configured before registering payment
Products may not exist in the sandbox; they must be created before adding order lines
Customer Luna SL may not exist; must be created using org. number 966920963
Currency assumed to be NOK; confirm if different
payload.suggested_first_action: Check or create customer Luna SL via POST /customer with organizationNumber=966920963
ordered_steps: 1. Ensure bank account is configured via GET /bank/account — set up if missing
2. Create or verify customer Luna SL via POST /customer with organizationNumber=966920963
3. Create or verify product 'Desarrollo de sistemas' via POST /product with number=5271, price=6950
4. Create or verify product 'Asesoría de datos' via POST /product with number=3613, price=7000
5. Create order for Luna SL via POST /order with customerId from step 2
6. Add order line for 'Desarrollo de sistemas' via POST /order/orderline with orderId, productId, quantity=1, unitPriceExcludingVat=6950, vatPercent=25
7. Add order line for 'Asesoría de datos' via POST /order/orderline with orderId, productId, quantity=1, unitPriceExcludingVat=7000, vatPercent=25
8. Convert order to invoice via PUT /order/{id}/invoice
9. Retrieve invoice ID from conversion response
10. Register full payment via POST /ledger/payment with invoiceId, amount=(6950+7000)*1.25=17437.50 NOK, paymentDate=today

planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Create order line. When creating several order lines, use /list for better performance.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
Set orderDate and deliveryDate (use today_iso from execution_brief).
When a product was created, ALWAYS include product={"id": product_id} on the orderline.
Use unitPriceExcludingVatCurrency for the price field.
For multiple lines, prefer POST /order/orderline/list for efficiency.
ALWAYS search first if product_number is provided: GET /product?number=<number> — sandbox pre-seeds products.
Only POST /product if GET returns 0 results.
Use 'number' field for the product number (NOT productNumber).
priceExcludingVat sets the base price. Also set vatType={"id": 3|5|6}.

- Customer Luna SL: id=108455438

So I don't need to create any of these. I need to:

1. Set up bank account (GET /ledger/account?number=1920, then PUT to configure)
2. Create order with customer reference


3. Add both order lines in a single request
4. Convert the order to an invoice
5. Register the full payment

The total amount comes to 17437.50 NOK after applying the 25% tax to the combined product costs. I'll start by fetching the bank account details and creating the order at the same time, since the bank account is needed for payment processing.

Though I'm noticing the invoice conversion endpoint might not be in the spec—let me verify that before proceeding.

Looking at the task, I need to:

2. Create order with customer Luna SL (already exists: id=108455438)

4. Convert order to invoice
5. Register full payment

All entities exist in sandbox. Let me start with parallel independent calls.

payload.headline: Perfect score achieved with one avoidable endpoint error on invoice conversion path
what_went_wrong: Used wrong endpoint PUT /order/402045391/invoice instead of PUT /order/402045391/:invoice, causing one 4xx-equivalent error and requiring a search_tripletex_api lookup to recover.
The search_tripletex_api call added latency and an extra API call that could have been avoided with prior knowledge of the :invoice action pattern.
what_worked: All 5 scoring checks passed for a perfect 8.0/8.0 raw score with correct order, lines, invoice, and payment.
Efficient parallel execution: bank account setup and order creation done simultaneously, order lines batched via /orderline/list.
what_to_try_next: Memorize the Tripletex action endpoint pattern (/:action suffix) for order-to-invoice conversion to avoid the wrong-path attempt and eliminate the search_tripletex_api recovery call.
Skip GET /ledger/account if bank account is already known from sandbox_discovery — use the known id directly to save one call.
Combine the PUT /ledger/account and POST /order/orderline/list calls more tightly to reduce total wall-clock time and call count from 10 to ~7-8.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account — bank account id 477420248 was likely already known from sandbox_discovery, making this lookup redundant.
search_tripletex_api({'query': 'order invoice convert'}) — needed only because wrong endpoint was tried first; avoidable with correct :invoice pattern knowledge.
